title: Chrome GPU out-of-bounds write can execute code outside the sandbox
summary: A crafted HTML page can exploit a GPU out-of-bounds write in Google Chrome before 158.0.8127.36 to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox.

severity.rationale: Untrusted web content can reach code execution outside the browser sandbox. Agents routinely open such content without a person reviewing each page.

affected.note: The Google CNA CVE record identifies Google Chrome versions before 158.0.8127.36 as affected.

exposure: Agent browsers rendering untrusted HTML are exposed, including browsers with the sandbox enabled. Trusted test-only browsing reduces exposure. Other channels and derived browsers require vendor-specific fix mappings.

params.instructions: Check Google Chrome Stable version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Install the patched Stable release for the platform and restart browser processes. Verify separate fix mappings for other channels and derived products.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
Limited Chrome claims to the Google CNA CVE record because the release post could not substantiate platform builds or unrelated fixes.
